title: fraxinus japonica var. stenocarpa
intro: Fraxinus japonica var. stenocarpa, commonly known as Japanese ash, is a plant species belonging to the Oleaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The therapeutic actions of Fraxinus japonica var. stenocarpa include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
